subject: Exact compute texture abort reproduced; ABI requirements before enabling lowering
body: Exact pan_nir_lower_tex.c:55 Unsupported texture source reproduced in authored compute sampler2D textureLod and installed accumulateKernel AIR44d4ef32. Artifacts gpu/build/texture-lowering-audit and gpu/build/ui-corpus-20261025/compute-baseline/44d4ef32f53e9f4951933a9709e3885b4facda9406cccd115f58a2f20bf5dd02/compute.spv. Current containment rejects live tex/image instructions before pan_preprocess and checks UBO/SSBO descriptor kind, returning rc4 empty output. This is not texture support. TGP1 has only binding bitmap0..7 and FAU address_lo/address_hi/size/offset records; no resource tables or texture/sampler descriptors. Need versioned package and dispatch ABI supplying table pointers, reflection binding/kind mapping, texture plus sampler descriptors and image read/write/atomic coherency. Then compiler lowers derefs to handles like pinned PanVK, preserving source semantics. Coordinate before enabling compiler resources; I own mali_compute_compiler.c/h and graphics compiler. Current graphics full source classification covers33source types/34ops; dynamic descriptor arrays are still refused, sparse/private vendor sources explicit errors. Gradients plus MinLod need faithful combined lowering: pinned Valhall currently ignores explicit gradients when min_lod exists.
